notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
description:
Cast Airbender's Reversal by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost reduced by Rakdos.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Airbender's Reversal targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve Airbender's Reversal, airbending Dualcaster Mage.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage from exile by paying {0} due to Rakdos.
Repeat from step 3.
